sourceChecks.note: The exact Casio Japan product route was independently retrievable on 2026-08-31. It identifies BGD-5650-1JF, publishes the 42.1 x 37.9 x 11.3 mm rectangular dimensions, 31 g mass, Tough Solar/Multi Band 6 operation, 100 m resistance, mineral glass, calendar and LED Super Illuminator, and a ¥19,800 tax-included list price.

The exact Casio Europe route was independently retrievable on 2026-08-31 and corroborates the 42.1 x 37.9 x 11.3 mm dimensions, 31 g, resin case and band, shock resistance, 100 m rating, Multi Band 6, Tough Solar, mineral glass, 125-180 mm band fit, and +/-15 seconds-per-month fallback accuracy.

The exact-reference retailer route was independently retrievable on 2026-08-31. It exposes a USD 93 new offer, exact BGD-5650-1JF identity, resin case and band, calibre 3493, and the technical feature set, but simultaneously displays Out of stock and Available 93/Add to Cart; availability is therefore normalized to unknown.

The exact BGD-5650-1 replacement-band record identifies Casio part 10652251, a resin band with a special mount/cutout and 14 mm interface. This is exact-family evidence for the physical interface, not a claim that the replacement listing is the watch's retail offer.
The exact-family Casio replacement-band record explicitly states that the band attaches by pushpins and uses a special 14 mm lug interface, supporting the normalized proprietary attachment type.

The general calibre manual is not used to establish the exact case-to-band construction or a single power-reserve duration. The exact product and replacement-part records supply the admitted facts instead.
